⚠ PyTorch .pt Model

.pt files cannot run directly in the browser. Export to ONNX with end-to-end NMS first:

Export to YOLO26 end-to-end ONNX (recommended):

from ultralytics import YOLO model = YOLO("your_model.pt") model.export(format="onnx", imgsz=640, end2end=True) # Upload the generated .onnx here

Place your .onnx file in Code/public/models/ for bundling, or upload it directly via the model drop zone above.

Option B — Local Flask inference server:

pip install ultralytics flask flask-cors from flask import Flask, request, jsonify from flask_cors import CORS from ultralytics import YOLO from PIL import Image import io app = Flask(__name__) CORS(app) model = YOLO("your_model.pt") @app.route("/predict", methods=["POST"]) def predict(): img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(request.data)) r = model(img)[0] preds = [{"name": r.names[int(b.cls)], "confidence": float(b.conf), "box": {"x1":float(b.xyxy[0][0]),"y1":float(b.xyxy[0][1]), "x2":float(b.xyxy[0][2]),"y2":float(b.xyxy[0][3])}} for b in r.boxes] return jsonify({"predictions": preds}) app.run(port=5000)

Running in demo / simulation mode until a valid .onnx is loaded.
